label: single_asset_fit_v1
contract: Full end-to-end single-asset overfit from the new model's own sample5040 checkpoint, NEVER old-method weights. Fresh AdamW; constant diagnostic LR1e-4, original betas0.95/0.999, decay, clipping, BF16, CE+0.5L1, original core model. Same fixed sampled geometry and labels on both arms; single_static repeats the query pose eight times, single_dynamic retains the eight real frames. Stop at1024 or two consecutive checks with all-frame/query XYZ L1<=0.01 (0.5percent query-mesh bbox side), structure CE<=0.01, exact generated parents, and query generation F1 within0.05 of GT-self oracle. Assert immutable input hashes; report whole-model same-weight grad-enabled training versus inference difference. Diagnostic weights cannot initialize formal training; this passing would prove only this sample is learnable, not full-dataset correctness. Formal configuration and approval unchanged.
